query:
UPDATE services SET
  shortDesc = 'From sewer excavations to parking lot preparation and pool installation, our fleet of excavators, dump trucks, and a skid steer handles any earthmoving job in London and Southwestern Ontario.',
  longDesc = 'Some jobs require digging. When they do, you want a crew with the right equipment and the experience to use it without damaging your property any more than necessary.

Our excavation fleet includes mini excavators for tight residential yards, a skid steer for confined access areas, dump trailers for soil removal, and a roll-off dump truck for larger volumes. For sewer and drain work, we also operate a combination vacuum and power flushing truck that can expose buried lines with minimal disruption before excavation begins.

Residential excavation work includes sewer line replacement, weeping tile installation, foundation waterproofing excavation, and pool installation preparation. Commercial and municipal work includes parking lot preparation, catch basin installation, and infrastructure upgrades.

We have been operating in London and Southwestern Ontario since 1970. Our operators know the soil conditions in this region, the depth requirements for local frost lines, and the permit requirements for excavation work near municipal infrastructure. We handle the permits and coordinate with utilities before any digging begins.

For sewer-related excavation, we combine the dig with a camera inspection so you know exactly what you are dealing with before the trench is open. If a trenchless repair is possible, we will tell you before we start digging.',
  benefits = '[{"title":"Full Excavation Fleet","desc":"Mini excavators, skid steer, dump trailers, and a roll-off dump truck give us the equipment to handle residential, commercial, and municipal excavation jobs of any size."},{"title":"Vacuum Truck for Precision Exposure","desc":"Our combination vac and power flushing truck can expose buried lines with minimal disruption before mechanical excavation begins."},{"title":"50 Years of Local Experience","desc":"Our operators know London soil conditions, frost line depths, and local permit requirements. We have been doing this work in Southwestern Ontario since 1970."},{"title":"Permits and Utility Coordination","desc":"We handle all required permits and coordinate with utilities before any digging begins, keeping the job legal and safe from start to finish."}]',
  metaTitle = 'Excavation Services London ON | Sewer and Earthmoving | Discount Drain',
  metaDesc = 'Professional excavation services in London Ontario. Sewer excavation, weeping tile, pool prep, parking lots. Full fleet, all permits handled. Call 519-451-8342.'
WHERE slug = 'excavation-services';
